title: Rig template
description: A rig template describes how a class of character is cut up, boned and layered. Templates are data: adding an animal or a custom character type is a new JSON file, not new code.

landmarks.description: Landmark id -> normalised position inside the character bounding box. x is 0..1 left to right, y is 0..1 top to bottom.

z.description: Draw order. Higher is in front.

bone.description: Bone this part is attached to.

anchors.description: Landmark ids that seed this part when there is no segmentation backend.

radius.description: Max radius as a fraction of the character bounding box height.

widen.description: Extra growth of the mask, in pixels.

head.description: Landmark id used as the bone origin.

tail.description: Landmark id used as the bone direction.

length.description: from_mask: length follows the size of the bound part. landmark: length is the distance between head and tail landmarks.

part.description: Part whose mask drives the length.

direction.description: Which way the bone points when the length comes from the mask.

proportions.description: Expected part sizes as a fraction of the character bounding box. Used to score segmentation results.
